messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call — detected high error rates and tenant isolation reports in prod-dedicated-pool-alpha (tenant-omega-17). Incident ID INC-3412001234. Auto-bridge created: https://redwood.incidents/bridge/3412001234

sara (on-call): I'm on the bridge now. joining... :phone:

matt (sre): seeing repeated GPU OOMs on nodes gpux-12..15 and KV cache eviction thrash. errors look like 500s from model runtime. sample log: ```[2024-11-23T21:05:12Z] ERROR kv_cache_key_evicted tenant=omega-17 key=prompt_cache_#12345
[2024-11-23T21:05:14Z] ERROR cuda_out_of_memory model=redwood-opt-3b shard=2
```

anya (eng): adding temporary routing rule to move tenant-omega-17 to fallback pool dedicated-beta-readonly and bypass prefix cache. will apply config now.

sara (on-call): running the routing update: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"omega-17","target_pool":"dedicated-beta-readonly","policy":"bypass-cache"}'```

deploy-bot: deployment queued -> routing-service v2.14.3 by @anya. CI: green. Starting rollout to region us-west-2.

matt (sre): mitigation in flight. watching error-rate dashboard — 5xx from omega-17 down from ~48% -> ~3% so far. autoscaler did thrash during initial cutover; node replacements queued.

sara (on-call): good. joseph, can you notify customer ops and prep a holding message? we need to confirm scope and whether any data plane egress occurred.

joseph (acctmgr): on it. quick Q: did traffic leave the VPC at any point? customer is asking about data exfil risk.

anya (eng): VPC isolation maintained the whole time — routing changes stayed internal. root problem appears to be excessive KV cache eviction because of memory pressure combined with a model quantization profile that spikes memory usage under certain input lengths. no public egress observed.

sara (on-call): immediate actions: 1) isolate tenant to fallback pool (done) 2) replace affected nodes gpux-12..15 (in progress) 3) apply conservative kernel params + reduce max batch size for redwood-opt-3b 4) roll quantization profile to v2-temp-reduced-memory.

elena (pm): I'll own the customer exec note. outline: Impact window, affected tenants, mitigation steps, RCA timeline, proposed credits. please confirm exact impact duration per tenant.

sara (on-call): metrics: tenant-omega-17 degraded from 21:04 -> 22:01 UTC (~57 mins). collateral impact: other tenants in pool saw brief slowdowns ~07-12 mins due to autoscaler instability.

joseph (acctmgr): drafting exec brief. proposing a goodwill credit: prorated monthly commit credit ~10% for the impacted hour and offer a dedicated design review with infra eng. any objections?

matt (sre): no objections. we'll include a technical appendix with logs and timeline. I'll upload artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/INC-3412001234/ and attach to RCA.

anya (eng): PR for kernel param and batch-size limit: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321 — currently in staging tests. if green I'll merge and push a hotfix to prod config.

sara (on-call): deploy-bot, can you confirm the routing rollback is stable and health checks are green?

deploy-bot: routing-service rollouts stable. health-checks: all green in us-west-2 and us-east-1 after 12m. No further 5xx spikes in the last 8m.

els (note): (system) severity escalated to SEV2 based on customer impact threshold.

elena (pm): schedule: quick customer sync tomorrow 10:00 PST for exec briefing. joseph — can you confirm attendee list and copy legal for SLA language?

joseph (acctmgr): confirmed. will send calendar invite and share draft by EOD. cc: legal.

sara (on-call): I'm creating the RCA draft and follow-up tasks. RCA doc: /docs/incidents/INC-3412001234-rca-draft.md — owners: matt (root cause & logs), anya (fix & PR), elena (exec comms), joseph (credits/contract).

matt (sre): timeline note: observed anomaly at 3412000432 (UTC), mitigation began 3412001234 (routing change), perceived resolution 3412004078 (nodes replaced & config pushed). I'll populate a detailed timeline in the RCA doc and attach perf dumps.

sara (on-call): follow-ups: 1) alert tuning to detect KV eviction cascade earlier (owner: matt) 2) runbook update for tenant isolation playbook (owner: anya) 3) customer comms + credit calculation (owner: joseph) 4) post-incident blameless review with infra (owner: elena).

anya (eng): note: we'll add a mitigation knob to allow per-tenant max-memory overrides for model shards to avoid cross-tenant noise. filing infra ticket now.

sara (on-call): closing live mitigation phase. we'll monitor for 2 hours on the bridge, then transition to post-incident channel and RCA cadence. thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status -> monitoring. created follow-up task INC-3412001234-FU for RCA and customer outreach.

elena (pm): thanks team. I'll sync with execs with the draft after joseph's note. meeting invite will include the SRE appendix and the mitigation PR links.

joseph (acctmgr): sending customer note now (holding language) — will share final after legal review.

sara (on-call): great. stand down from live bridge but remain on pager. will update if anything regresses.

(End of thread)
